name: Tampa Bay Comic & Pop Culture Convention
blurb: Tampa's annual comic and pop-culture convention at the Tampa Bay Convention Center, with TV/film guests, comic creators, authors and cosplay guests.

editions.evidence: Wayback Machine snapshot (2026-09-30) of the official homepage: 'Tampa Bay Comic & Pop Culture Convention August 20th - 22nd, 2027 Tampa Bay Convention Center' and 'Save the Date for TBCC27 ... back in 2027 from August 20th to the 22nd with a whole new Guestlist'

notes: The live site returned a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' interstitial with HTTP 403 on every attempt (default Chromium, msedge channel, and a fresh render with a 9s wait), consistent with an IP-level block rather than a passable JS challenge, so per the retry-once rule I fell back to a Wayback Machine snapshot (2026-09-30) of the homepage, which is recent enough to show the current 'Save the Date for TBCC27' announcement; the cover image is the archived copy of the official 1080x1080 convention logo. The guest nav (TV & Film, Comic Creators, Authors, Cosplayers, Panelists) still reflects the prior edition, and the site itself says the 2027 show will have 'a whole new Guestlist', so guests is 'none-yet'. WebSearch/WebFetch separately confirmed a September 4-6, 2026 edition at the same venue, but that date already ended before the 2026-10-05 research window, so it is not listed; no organizer name was found (LEAP Event Technology appears only as the ticketing platform, not a stated producer).
